exceptions.reason: Unpatched upstream (digitalbazaar/forge#1152 open). Production-graph transitive via @voltagent/core -> @mymediset/sap-ai-provider -> @sap-cloud-sdk -> jks-js, reached only when the SAP provider is explicitly configured, and only to parse an operator-supplied local JKS keystore. Station verifies no attacker-controlled RSA signatures through this chain, so the forgery primitive in CVE-2026-85393 has no reachable target. Re-run npm run audit:policy on every VoltAgent core or @mymediset/sap-ai-provider update.
